verdict.rationale: Paxos is clearly API-first. Documented APIs cover identity onboarding, crypto and fiat transfers, fiat accounts, conversions, orders and quotes, mint/redeem orchestrations, and event listing, plus FIX and WebSocket interfaces. However, several operations appear to be Dashboard-only: webhook registration and configuration (including RPS limits), webhook test events, and the sandbox Fund button. No parity statement or OpenAPI spec was found (all probed paths returned 404). Missing for 10: API-based webhook registration/management, API equivalents for Dashboard test/fund actions, programmatic API credential/scope management, an explicit UI–API parity commitment, and a published OpenAPI spec.
